description: Shell script for testing 'git status' behavior with ignored files and directories, including various scenarios with --ignored and --ignore options, handling of BOM in .gitignore, pathspecs, subdirectories, and submodules.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and checks the result.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the provided output is empty.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in a specified directory.
